svg.title: prepare_data — every gate, check and branch in one call
svg.desc: Named uploaded files plus their call-time SHA-256 hashes and recipe, or saved simulation replicates, are the two sources. Repeated applied calls return the full saved result without another attempt; running duplicates return progress; failures can be retried. Files retain complete support windows inside an optional span. Identical retained ingestion and semantic extraction requests reuse their first validated result across studies. Every worker request covers one variable and one window. Both sources share row validation and data checks; data-quality findings are saved as warnings.
